action_instruction: Reviewing the Paris to Cairo flight results heading and main table
intent: PRIMARY: review completion of the Paris to Cairo flight results heading and table; role=text | HINTS: main results table
rationale: The heading, column headers, and five Choose This Flight row actions are confirmed.

intent: whether the flight results heading includes Paris and Cairo

action_params.condition: The heading includes Paris and Cairo.
action_params.query: whether the flight results heading includes Paris and Cairo

intent: whether the flights table displays the Airline, Flight #, departure time, arrival time, and Price columns

action_params.condition: The table shows Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price columns.
action_params.query: whether the flights table displays the Airline, Flight #, departure time, arrival time, and Price columns
action_params.code_js: ['Airline','Flight #','Departure Time','Arrival Time','Price'].every(label => Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('th')).some(th => th.textContent.trim() === label || (label === 'Departure Time' && th.textContent.includes('Departs:')) || (label === 'Arrival Time' && th.textContent.includes('Arrives:'))))
locators: internal:text="Choose Flight # Airline Departs: Paris Arrives: Cairo Price Choose This Flight"i

intent: whether every displayed flight result row has a Choose This Flight action

action_params.condition: Every displayed flight row includes a Choose This Flight action.
action_params.query: whether every displayed flight result row has a Choose This Flight action
locators: internal:text="Choose Flight # Airline Departs: Paris Arrives: Cairo Price Choose This Flight"i

assertion_tree.description: the heading includes Paris and Cairo, the table shows Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price columns, and every displayed flight row includes a Choose This Flight action

sub_results.description: The heading includes Paris and Cairo.
The table shows Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price columns.
Every displayed flight row includes a Choose This Flight action.

assertion_tree.verification: The flight results heading includes Paris and Cairo; the flights table has Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price columns; and every displayed flight row has a Choose This Flight action.
